title: The Patient One
intro: Long ago, in the earliest days of human history, two souls stood before their Creator with offerings. One was accepted, one was not. What followed would become the first great tragedy between siblings - one act of patient restraint and one act of bitter vengeance. Can you uncover who I am?
clues: I was born in the very first days of human existence on earth
I was a child of the very first pair of humans to ever walk this earth
I once offered a sacrifice from the best of my flock to please my Creator
My offering was accepted from above, while my sibling's offering was rejected
When threatened with death, I chose not to lift my hand against my sibling
I became the first person in all of human history to be wrongfully killed by another

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Habil (Abel), son of Adam
Qabil (Cain), son of Adam
Adam, the first human
Nuh (Noah)
Ibrahim (Abraham)

The great flood of Nuh
The destruction of Fir'awn's army

The battle against Jalut (Goliath)

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
